title: Linear Inequalities in One and Two Variables
seo_title: Algebra I Linear Inequalities Worksheets (TEKS A.5B, A.3D)
standard_text: A.5B solve linear inequalities in one variable, including those for which the application of the distributive property is necessary and for which variables are included on both sides; A.2H write linear inequalities in two variables given a table of values, a graph, and a verbal description; A.3D graph the solution set of linear inequalities in two variables on the coordinate plane
meta_desc: Free Algebra I inequality worksheets for Texas TEKS A.5B, A.2H and A.3D: multi-step and compound inequalities, graphing inequalities in two variables and word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Flip the sign when dividing by a negative.
key_sub: Dashed line for < and >; solid for ≤ and ≥.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Solve like an equation, but flip the sign when you multiply or divide by a negative number.
  • For y > mx + b, draw a dashed line and shade above. For ≥, use a solid line.
  • Test a point like (0, 0) to check the shading.

Examples

Example

−3x + 5 ≤ 17

−3x ≤ 12

divide by −3, flip

Answer: x ≥ −4

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Not flipping the signDividing by a negative flips the inequality.
Solid line for < or >Use a dashed line.
Shading the wrong sideTest (0, 0).

items.q: What is the solution of 2x > 6 and 2x < 4?
items.e: x > 3 and x < 2 cannot both be true: no solution.

items.q: What is the solution of x > 1 or x < 4?
items.e: Every number is greater than 1 or less than 4 (or both): all real numbers.

items.q: A streaming plan costs $12 a month. Liam has at most $100 to spend. Which inequality shows the number of months m?
items.e: “At most” means ≤: 12m ≤ 100.

items.q: A rectangle has width 6 ft and length x ft. Its perimeter must be at most 50 ft. Which is correct?
Which inequality is the same as −4 < −2x ≤ 6?
items.e: Divide every part by −2 and reverse both signs: 2 > x ≥ −3, which is −3 ≤ x < 2.

items.q: Which number is a solution of 2x − 3 < −5 or 2x − 3 > 7?
items.e: The inequality means x < −1 or x > 5. Only 6 works.

items.q: Healthy body temperature is between 97 °F and 99 °F, inclusive. Which compound inequality shows the temperature t?
items.e: “Inclusive” means both ends are included: 97 ≤ t ≤ 99.

items.q: Which number is a solution of −1 < 3x + 2 < 11?
items.e: Subtract 2 and divide by 3: −1 < x < 3. Only 2 works.

items.q: A school dance needs at least 120 tickets sold to break even. 47 have been sold and 8 students each sell t more. What is the smallest t?
items.e: 47 + 8t ≥ 120, so 8t ≥ 73 and t ≥ 9.125. The smallest whole number is 10.
